en.hubeali: And by this chain, from Muhammad Bin Jamhour, raising it,
‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If one comes across an innovation, so appreciates him (sides with him), so rather he has assisted in the demolition of Al-Islam’.
en.sarwar: 3. It is narrated through the same chain of narrators from Muhammad ibn Jumhur in a marfu’ manner from the Messenger of Allah who has said the following.
“If one would meet an innovator and considers him great such person has, in fact, the destruction of Islam.”
